Read as UTC, the epoch values give 2026-01-18 ~06:04, matching the usual ~06:00 start of each day's transactions. The format is therefore unambiguous and can be parsed explicitly.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.88,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS
WITH parsed AS (
  SELECT *,
         CASE WHEN regexp_matches(txn_ts, '^[0-9]{12,13}$') THEN epoch_ms(CAST(txn_ts AS BIGINT))
              ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS ts_parsed
  FROM raw_transactions
  WHERE status = 'POSTED'
)
SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id,
       customer_id,
       CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id,
       CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount,
       ts_parsed AS txn_ts,
       CAST(ts_parsed AS DATE) AS txn_date
FROM parsed;"}}
